papers.title: Product Gap Mechanisms for Multi-Facility Location
papers.titleZh: 多设施选址中的乘积间隙机制
papers.abstract: We study randomized strategyproof mechanisms for locating multiple facilities on the real line. We introduce the \emph{Product-Gap mechanism}, which selects $k$ reported locations with probability proportional to the product of the consecutive gaps between them and opens facilities at the selected locations. We prove that, for every $k\geq 2$, the mechanism achieves a tight approximation ratio of $2k$ for social cost. We then study its incentive properties and show that it is strategyproof in expectation for $k=2$ and $k=3$, but is not strategyproof for $k\geq 4$. In particular, the mechanism gives strategyproof $4$- and $6$-approximations for two and three facilities, respectively. Finally, for two facilities, we combine Product-Gap with the Proportional mechanism of Lu et al. We show that an optimized report-independent mixture is strategyproof and has a tight approximation ratio of $(74+4\sqrt{3})/23\approx 3.519$ on the line, improving upon the previous factor of $4$.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在多设施选址中难以兼顾激励相容与效率？传统确定性机制在多个设施下近似比随人数增长，而随机机制虽能突破此障碍，但此前尚不清楚是否存在对三个及以上设施仍保持策略证明的常数近似机制。本文聚焦于填补这一理论空白。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一条线上n个代理报告位置，机制需随机选择k个位置建设施，目标是最小化期望社会成本（即到最近设施的距离总和）。代理可能谎报位置以降低自身成本，因此机制需满足策略证明（期望下不鼓励谎报），同时提供社会成本的近似保证。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 作者提出了‘乘积间隙机制’：以k个报告点间连续间隙的乘积为权重选点。该机制对任意k均达2k近似比且紧，特别地，在k=2和k=3时策略证明成立，分别给出4和6近似；但k≥4时不满足策略证明。此外，结合已有机制优化混合后，两设施情形下逼近比降至约3.519。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 证明依赖于将机制转化为‘随机切割’采样过程，并通过服务间隙展开分析期望成本。关键技巧包括利用最优聚类的连续性、构造电荷不等式关联机制与最优解，以及通过潜在函数和局部不等式归纳证明策略证明性，尤其在k=3时采用最近点删除法处理偏离收益。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 机制仅在k≤3时策略证明，更高维空间无直接推广。其价值在于首次给出超过两个设施的常数近似策略证明机制，揭示了k=3为临界点。最值得阅读的是机制设计思想、紧近似分析及策略证明边界的技术处理。

papers.title: Random Cap: Optimal Informationally Robust Delegation
papers.titleZh: 随机上限：最优信息稳健委托
papers.abstract: Are simple delegation rules optimal under ambiguity? We study delegation when the principal knows the mean, but not the distribution, of the agent's private information. In a quadratic constant-bias environment, the robustly optimal randomized mechanism is a random cap: the principal draws and reveals an upper bound below which the agent chooses freely. Randomization strictly outperforms every deterministic cap by hedging against cap-specific worst-case distributions. We characterize random caps through nondecreasing and concave expected-action rules and construct the solution using a saddle-point approach. The worst-case distribution features an exponential survival function over its continuous region and an atom at the upper endpoint. Under regularity conditions, the result extends to convex-order ambiguity. When the mean is below the agent's bias, the optimal mechanism additionally requires an incentive-neutral outcome lottery.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当委托方只知道代理人的私有信息均值而不知其分布时，简单的确定性委托规则（如固定上限）是否仍是最优的？现有研究通常依赖特定分布假设，导致结论缺乏普适性。本文探讨在信息不完全的环境中，是否存在一种稳健的委托机制，能够应对任意符合均值约束的未知分布，从而解决制度设计中的适应性难题。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个主从博弈：代理人知道状态θ∈[0,1]，其理想动作为θ，而委托方的理想动作为θ−b（b>0为偏差）。委托方承诺一个激励相容的随机机制，在仅知E[θ]=μ的前提下，最大化最坏情况下的期望效用。自然（对手）选择满足均值约束的分布G，形成极小极大问题。机制被限制为直接机制，且无货币转移。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，最优稳健机制是一种‘随机上限’：委托方预先随机选择一个上限Z，并允许代理人在[0,Z]内自由决策。该机制严格优于任何确定性上限，因其通过随机化对冲了针对特定上限的最坏分布攻击。此外，文章刻画了此类机制的充要条件——期望行动函数非减且凹，并指出最坏分布具有指数尾部加原子点的结构。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用鞍点构造法，通过双重无差异论证建立最优性：一方面，构造一个使所有确定性上限表现相同的最坏分布G*；另一方面，设计一个随机上限机制π*，使得所有支撑在特定区间上的均值为μ的分布对其评价相同。利用积分变换与虚拟项分析，将原问题转化为两个匹配的等价问题，结合凸序理论推广至更一般的不确定性集合。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于二次损失与恒定偏差假设，难以直接推广至状态相关偏差或非凸偏好。机制虽具简洁性，但随机化在现实中可能面临执行障碍。然而，其对随机机制价值的揭示、对分布鲁棒性的精细刻画以及鞍点构造方法，为后续研究提供了清晰的技术路径与深刻洞见，值得深入研读其证明结构与扩展部分。

papers.title: Temporal Fair Division of Indivisible Mixed Manna: Tractable Settings
papers.titleZh: 不可分混合物品的时间公平分配：可处理情形
papers.abstract: We study temporal fair division of indivisible mixed manna. Items arrive over time and must be allocated irrevocably; an item may be a good for some agents, a chore for others, and neutral for the rest. We require the cumulative allocation after every round to be envy-free up to one item (TEF1). Although deciding whether a TEF1 allocation exists is NP-hard even for goods, we identify several tractable settings. First, with at most $k$ item types, an online cyclic rule guarantees EF$\lceil k/2\rceil$ after every item arrival. Thus, every instance with at most two types admits an online TEF1 allocation; moreover, when the numbers of agents and types are fixed, TEF1 existence can be decided in polynomial time. Second, under agreement after agent-specific scaling, provided that the scaling factors are known before arrivals begin, an online rule produces an allocation that is EF1 and Pareto optimal after every item arrival. Third, for a two-part arrival sequence with common rankings, we give a rule that is EF1 after every item arrival. Fourth, when the number of agents is fixed and values are bounded integers, we give an exact pseudo-polynomial algorithm for deciding TEF1 existence. Finally, for goods, every TEF1 allocation gives each agent at least $1/n$ of her maximin share after every round; this factor is tight even for identical valuations and two rounds. Deciding whether an exact temporal maximin-share allocation exists is NP-hard for both goods and chores, even with identical valuations, two agents, and two rounds.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为何在物品随时间到达时仍需保证每一步的公平？传统公平分配通常只关注最终结果，但在教学任务、值班安排等场景中，长期处于不利位置会引发不满。本文研究不可分混合物品（同一物品对不同人可能是好物、坏物或中性）的逐轮分配，要求每一轮后累积分配都满足时间公平性（TEF1），即任一代理人的嫉妒可通过删除一个物品消除。问题是：在何种条件下该要求可被高效满足？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型中有n个代理人，物品逐轮到达且必须立即永久分配。每个物品对各代理人的价值可正、负或零，构成混合物品实例。目标是使每轮后的累积分配都满足TEF1，并尽可能兼顾帕累托最优。关键挑战在于物品价值异质且分配不可逆，导致无法回溯调整。作者考虑四种结构化设定：少量物品类型、基于缩放的一致估值、两阶段序列中的共同排序、以及有界整数值。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文给出了四个可处理情形下的正面结果：当物品类型数k≤2时，存在在线循环规则保证TEF1；在代理人间存在一致缩放因子时，可设计在线规则同时实现TEF1与帕累托最优；对于前半段全为坏物、后半段部分人视为好物的两阶段序列，存在多项式时间EF1分配规则；固定代理人数量且价值为有界整数时，可用伪多项式动态规划决定TEF1是否存在。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过多种技术应对动态公平难题：利用类型平衡的循环分配控制嫉妒传播；借助标准化价值设计贪心规则，在保持效率的同时维持公平；采用双阶段循环顺序分离好物与坏物的影响；并构建状态空间为 envy gap 与极值项的动态规划，精确追踪每步的公平性条件。这些方法共同体现了对加性估值下嫉妒演化路径的精细控制能力。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果高度依赖结构化假设，如类型数少、特定估值模式或已知序列划分，通用情形仍是NP难。机制多为存在性构造，实际部署需预知全局参数。尽管如此，论文系统梳理了时间公平性的可解边界，其标准化思想、双阶段设计与动态规划框架为后续研究提供了清晰工具箱。最值得读的是模型抽象方式与针对不同结构的技术适配策略。

papers.title: The Order of Binary Experiments under Endogenous Stopping
papers.titleZh: 内生停止下的二元实验序
papers.abstract: We study the comparison of binary statistical experiments in large samples where information is acquired sequentially and the number of observations can depend on realized evidence. We introduce two orders. Stopping dominance compares experiments by their ability to reproduce the outcomes of arbitrary stopping policies, while decision dominance compares their value in finite decision problems with costly observations. Our main result shows that the two orders coincide and are characterized by coordinatewise dominance of the two directed Kullback--Leibler divergences. Moreover, strict dominance implies eventual strict value dominance in every decision problem in which learning the state can change the optimal action. The key result behind this characterization is an exact simulation theorem: any binary target experiment can be generated from repeated observations of a source experiment with expected sample sizes attaining the two KL lower bounds up to an additive constant that depends only on the source.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当信息可以逐次获取且观测次数取决于已见证据时，如何比较不同信息源的价值？传统Blackwell序基于一次性观测或固定样本量，在大数据和序贯决策日益普遍的背景下显得不足。本文关注在允许自适应采样下，何种信息结构能在所有决策问题中一致优于另一种，填补了大规模序贯学习中信息比较的理论空白。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个未知状态为0或1的二元世界，决策者可从两个信息源F或G中重复抽取独立同分布信号，并自主决定何时停止。每个实验由一对概率分布定义，停止策略基于历史信号和随机化。目标是比较F和G在精确模拟任意停止策略输出或在带成本决策中的表现能力，核心是刻画何种条件下F能系统性替代G。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出并证明‘停止支配’与‘决策支配’两种序等价，且均由两个方向的KL散度不等式完全刻画：F支配G当且仅当其正向和反向KL散度均不小于G。进一步，严格支配意味着在任何可能改变最优行动的决策问题中，当观测成本足够小时，F始终带来更高价值，实现了序贯信息价值的紧刻画。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 证明核心是一个精确模拟定理：任一二元目标实验可通过源实验的序贯观测精确生成，期望样本量达到KL下界的加性常数内。技术上结合了似然比过程的连续化嵌入、边界命中时间分析及混合两值分布表示目标似然比，通过构造性模拟策略统一上下界，从而连接信息论与序贯决策。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果目前局限于二元状态，多元情形的充分性尚不明确。证明依赖似然比的标量结构，难以直接推广。尽管如此，论文提供了序贯信息比较的新范式，其模拟思想与KL主导条件极具启发性，适合关注信息价值、学习效率与实验设计的读者深入研读其模型构建与证明技巧。

papers.title: SafeBranch: Branch-Pair Safety Alignment for Embodied Agents
papers.titleZh: SafeBranch: 面向具身智能体的分支对安全对齐
papers.abstract: Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety. Training such agents to act safely is difficult, since safety and task success are distinct objectives, and safety arises only at a small number of safety-critical steps within a trajectory. Standard supervision is insufficient: imitating safe trajectories teaches behavior without explaining why it is safe, and contrasting arbitrary safe and unsafe trajectories mixes the safety signal with unrelated differences. We propose SafeBranch, a framework that aligns an embodied actor on safety through branch pairs constructed from the actor's own unsafe rollouts via environment rollback. SafeBranch rolls each unsafe rollout back to the safety-critical step that caused the violation, queries the actor for a safe alternative, and pairs the original action with the alternative so that the two branches differ only at that step. The trained actor acts safely at deployment with no critic in the loop. On IS-Bench, SafetyALFRED, and out-of-distribution variants with unseen tasks and objects, it handles safety reliably without sacrificing task success, achieving roughly ten times more safe successes than the untrained baseline on the unseen-object variant.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 具身智能体虽能执行指令任务，但常因行为引发环境中的连锁风险而违反安全约束，这类交互式安全问题难以通过传统任务成功信号训练解决。现有方法依赖推理时外部模块进行安全过滤，导致部署开销高且未真正提升智能体自身决策能力。核心难点在于安全决策仅发生在少数关键步骤，而标准监督信号无法精准定位这些分支点。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在家庭模拟环境中评估智能体完成多步操作任务的表现，输入为视觉-语言指令与环境观测，输出为动作序列。模型需同时达成任务成功与规避安全隐患，评价指标包括安全成功率、任务成功率与安全召回率。实验涵盖原始分布及含未知物体与任务的分布外变体，验证方法的泛化能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出SafeBranch框架，首次实现对具身规划器的端到端安全对齐训练。其核心是构建仅在安全关键步骤存在差异的分支对数据，并通过偏好学习使智能体内化安全决策。在多个基准上显著超越基线，安全成功率提升近十倍，且无需推理时外部判别器，证明了训练期安全引导的有效性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法利用智能体自身的失败轨迹，通过环境回滚至安全违规的关键步骤，借助安全判别器生成修正反馈，引导智能体在同一情境下采样安全替代动作，形成‘分支对’。随后移除反馈线索，确保训练信号仅来自原始上下文。通过分支偏好优化（BranchPO）目标对齐模型，使智能体学会在正确时机采取安全行动。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖可回滚的仿真环境与外部判别器构建训练数据，限制了其在真实世界的直接应用。尽管性能优越，但未完全消除对辅助模块的训练依赖。最值得阅读的是其问题抽象方式——将安全决策建模为分支选择，以及通过回滚与反事实重构实现高效数据构造的设计思路。

papers.title: World-Model-Grounded LLM Planning for AUV and ASV Navigation Near Offshore Wind Farms
papers.titleZh: 基于世界模型的大语言模型规划用于AUV与ASV在近海风电场附近的导航
papers.abstract: Large language models can turn a natural-language mission into a sequence of robot actions, but they do not have a sense of physics: they cannot judge how long a command should run, or whether it will make the robot drift into an obstacle. We proposed the use of a world model to expand the capabilities of Large Language model-based planners. Our method has three components: a physics-grounded neural world model, a three-phase gradient-based trajectory optimizer, and a Model Predictive Controller (MPC)-style closed-loop replanner with a trust-region guard. The language model decides what to do, and the world model decides how long, whether that means driving eight thrusters through 6 DOF or two differential thrusters through 3 DOF. We evaluate two marine vehicle classes operating near offshore wind infrastructure: a 6-DOF Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) and a 3-DOF differential-drive Autonomous Surface Vehicle (ASV). In five benchmark missions per platform, both vehicles reach every goal with zero predicted collisions, and both transfer to GazeboSim under ocean current, waves, and thruster dynamics, remaining collision-free and cutting GazeboSim goal-distance error versus the ungrounded baseline by 70-82% (ASV) and roughly 93% (AUV), after a residual fine-tuning pass that separately reduces surrogate rollout Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) by 60% (AUV) and 69% (ASV). For the ASV we further demonstrate a Vision language model (VLM)-assisted semantic-mapping pipeline that extracts obstacles and environmental context from satellite imagery, nautical charts, and forecast Application Programming Interface (API) instead of onboard sensors, reaching 96% navigability accuracy as a drop-in replacement for hand-specified obstacle geometry.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 大语言模型（LLM）能将自然语言任务分解为动作序列，但在物理环境中缺乏对动力学的理解，无法判断动作持续时间或是否会因水流、惯性导致碰撞。在海上机器人靠近风电设施的复杂场景中，几何上合理的指令可能因水动力耦合、推进器延迟等物理效应而失败。本文针对这一‘语义合理但物理不可行’的问题，探索如何让LLM规划与真实动力学结合。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定为两种海洋机器人——6自由度水下潜航器（AUV）和3自由度水面船（ASV）——在风电场附近执行导航任务。输入是自然语言指令，输出是一系列宏观动作及其最优执行时长。系统通过一个融合解析动力学模型与神经网络残差的世界模型进行轨迹预测，并在GazeboSim仿真中测试闭环性能，评估指标包括目标到达率、碰撞次数和终点误差。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出一种将LLM与物理世界模型结合的规划框架，在五个任务中均实现100%无碰撞到达目标，显著优于未经物理校正的基线方法。其核心贡献在于实现了语言决策与物理可行性的解耦：LLM决定‘做什么’，世界模型决定‘做多久’，并通过MPC式重规划应对扰动。结果表明该方法在仿真到仿真的迁移中仍保持高精度。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法由三部分构成：一个混合式世界模型（解析Fossen模型+神经残差），一个三阶段梯度优化器用于调整动作时长，以及带信任区域保护的闭环重规划机制。关键在于利用可微分世界模型反向传播优化动作持续时间，并通过语义映射管道从卫星图等外部数据提取障碍物，使低成本ASV无需搭载昂贵传感器即可感知环境。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 主要局限在于无法修复LLM生成的动作序列拓扑错误，优化仅限于调整固定结构下的时长。此外，实验局限于仿真，尚未验证真实海洋环境表现。尽管如此，该文的价值在于清晰展示了LLM与物理模型协同的设计模式，最值得细读的是其系统集成思路、梯度优化与信任区域机制的设计，以及VLM辅助语义建图的实际可行性。

papers.title: OrthoSkillVLA: Continual Skill Learning via Gradient-Informed Skill Subspace Adaptation
papers.titleZh: OrthoSkillVLA: 基于梯度感知技能子空间适应的持续技能学习
papers.abstract: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for robot learning, but sequentially adapting them to diverse skills can perturb the representations and velocity mappings used by previous skills, leading to catastrophic forgetting. Architecture-based approaches improve retention by isolating skills but lead to increased inference footprint. Recent subspace-constrained methods restrict parameter updates in an orthogonal subspace to minimize interference but impose a unified constraint on the entire model. We analyze the distinct roles of internal VLA components and identify two VLA-specific challenges. First, the VLM maintains broad semantic representations, making it vulnerable to capacity exhaustion, whereas the ActionHead refines semantics into localized velocity patterns that are highly sensitive to perturbations. Second, the final velocity decoder serves as a readout layer. Freezing it forms an output-stage expressivity bottleneck, while updating it risks overwriting previous velocity mappings. To this end, we propose OrthoSkillVLA, a parameter-efficient framework for continual skill learning in pretrained VLA models without demonstration replay. Given the representation heterogeneity, we impose separate subspace constraints on the VLM and ActionHead, preserving reusable semantic capacity while protecting localized velocity patterns. For the output layer, we introduce a lightweight feature-aware MoE decoder, where each skill is allocated a compact expert and a training-free router selects the expert according to feature-space affinity. Extensive simulated and real-world evaluations, together with ablations, demonstrate that OrthoSkillVLA better preserves prior skills while acquiring new ones.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽能泛化多种行为，但在持续学习新技能时易破坏旧技能的语义与速度映射，导致灾难性遗忘。现有方法或因架构扩展增加推理开销，或采用统一子空间约束忽视模块异质性，难以兼顾语义可塑性与速度模式稳定性，制约了机器人长期自主学习的部署。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在模拟与真实机械臂环境中评估模型持续学习能力，任务为顺序掌握不同操作技能而不回放历史数据。输入为图像与语言指令，输出为末端执行器的速度场。通过平均成功率、前向迁移、后向遗忘等指标衡量性能，并在X-VLA等基线上对比，验证方法在保持旧技能的同时高效习得新技能的能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出OrthoSkillVLA框架，核心贡献在于模块感知的子空间预算分配与特征感知的MoE解码器。实验显示其显著优于现有子空间方法，在模拟和真实场景中均大幅降低遗忘率并提升最终成功率，证明分离处理VLM与ActionHead、释放输出层表达力对持续学习至关重要。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法基于梯度信息估计各模块的历史技能子空间，并将新技能更新限制在其正交补空间中，分别设置VLM宽松、ActionHead严格的能量阈值以平衡容量分配。对于速度解码器，引入无需训练的投影路由MoE结构，每个技能独享轻量子网络，通过特征空间亲和性选择专家，既避免共享权重干扰又保持低延迟。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖梯度作为子空间代理，可能受优化路径影响；MoE路由虽免训练但假设技能特征可分，在高度相似任务下可能混淆。最值得阅读的是其对VLA模块异质性的洞察与针对性系统设计，为参数高效持续学习提供了可推广的架构思路，尤其适用于资源受限的具身智能体部署场景。

papers.title: HiTac-WAM: A Hierarchical Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.titleZh: HiTac-WAM: 一种用于接触丰富型机器人操作的分层触觉世界动作模型
papers.abstract: World action models jointly predict future visual observations and actions, whereas existing tactile-aware variants typically represent future touch as an image or latent stream without modeling the physical dependencies that organize tactile states hierarchically. We present HiTac-WAM, a hierarchical tactile world action model that forecasts a sequence of future tactile states for each candidate action chunk before execution. The forecast factorizes into contact state, a 3D deformation field, and slip risk, organized as a directed hierarchy in which each downstream stage is conditioned on stop-gradient signals from preceding stages. A directed attention mask allows tactile queries to attend to the video-action context of each candidate while preventing video and action queries from attending to tactile tokens. For planning, HiTac-WAM ranks candidate action chunks using tactile forecasts and task-progress estimates. For execution, the selected tactile forecast is retained as a reference; persistent discrepancies between predicted and observed tactile states trigger corrective replanning. HiTac-WAM achieves a mean contact F1 of 0.921; under matched training budgets, the directed hierarchy reduces 3D displacement L2 error by 17.6% relative to the deformation-only predictor and improves slip AUPRC by 60.4% relative to the slip-only predictor. Across chip grasping, blackboard erasing, and USB insertion, selection guided by the hierarchical forecasts increases the average real-robot success rate from 31.1% to 61.1%, while the full system attains 72.2%.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在接触丰富的机器人操作中，仅靠视觉预测未来状态存在根本缺陷，因为接触、形变和打滑等关键物理状态难以从图像中直接观察，尤其在遮挡下更甚。现有触觉感知的世界模型通常将触觉输出作为单一图像或隐变量流进行预测，忽略了接触、形变与滑移之间的物理依赖关系。这导致候选动作即使视觉上合理，也可能因错误的接触行为而失败，从而限制了规划的可靠性。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究在给定当前视觉、语言指令和机器人状态的前提下，对每个候选动作片段预测其未来的触觉状态序列。输入包括RGB视频、动作序列和双侧触觉历史，输出为结构化的触觉轨迹，包含接触状态、三维形变场和打滑风险。模型基于预训练的世界动作模型扩展触觉分支，在仿真与真实机器人平台（IMETA-Y1）上通过三个任务——芯片抓取、黑板擦除和USB插入——评估成功率，并使用接触F1、形变误差和滑移AUPRC等指标量化预测精度。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了HiTac-WAM，首次将触觉预测建模为从接触到形变再到滑移风险的有向分层结构，显式编码其物理依赖。实验表明，该层次结构使3D形变预测误差降低17.6%，滑移检测AUPRC提升60.4%。在真实机器人上，基于触觉预测的动作选择将平均成功率从31.1%提升至61.1%，结合执行时的预测验证，最终达到72.2%，显著优于基线方法，验证了分层建模与预测驱动控制的有效性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 模型采用分层预测头：接触状态作为基础，其输出通过停梯度信号条件化形变预测，而形变与接触共同条件化滑移风险预测，形成物理一致的因果链。通过定向注意力掩码，触觉查询可访问视觉-动作上下文，但反向不可，确保触觉不干扰主干预测。在规划阶段，候选动作根据触觉成本与任务进展得分排序；执行时则持续比对观测与所选预测，偏差持续超标触发重规划，实现闭环修正。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 论文未单独评估模型在生成动作上的预测质量，且滑移风险未校准为可靠报警信号，限制了其在安全敏感场景的应用。消融实验虽支持分层设计优势，但未测试更强基线如独立多任务学习。尽管如此，论文的价值在于清晰展示了如何将物理先验嵌入预测模型以提升控制鲁棒性。最值得细读的是其系统设计、分层机制与真实机器人闭环验证部分。

papers.title: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
papers.titleZh: DECOWAM: 面向足式移动操作的解耦全身世界-动作模型
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions. Here we introduce DECOWAM, a whole-body world-action model that separates these factors through dedicated conditional interfaces. DECOWAM freezes an adapted FastWAM backbone and trains residual adapters, an action-equivalent future bottleneck distilled from privileged observations, adversarially separated base and arm latents, and base-velocity conditioning for video prediction. We further introduce ARMDOG, a real-robot dataset that synchronizes video, whole-body state and action, and language. On a fixed replay protocol, DECOWAM improved both future-video and action prediction over FastWAM, reducing action MSE by 21.7% with 25.95M trainable adaptation parameters. Across 79 closed-loop trials per method, it achieved the highest observed whole-body coordination and base-displacement robustness among the compared systems, while task completion remained comparable to the strongest baseline. These results show that embodiment-aware factorization can support parameter-efficient joint visual prediction and whole-body control under moving viewpoints.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型多针对固定基座机械臂，难以处理足式机器人移动过程中相机视角持续变化的问题。这类任务需同时协调高频手臂动作与低频底盘运动，且动作语义和控制节奏差异大。传统方法将所有信号混合建模，导致视频预测混淆自运动与场景动态，限制了具身智能在复杂环境下的联合感知与控制能力。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究如何从单帧图像、本体状态和语言指令出发，联合预测未来视频序列与多步全身动作。输入包括当前RGB图、14维状态（含臂部、夹爪、底盘速度）及文本指令，输出为8帧未来图像和48步动作序列。基于FastWAM主干，在真实机器人平台采集的同步数据集ARMDOG上进行回放评估，并开展闭环实物测试。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出DECOWAM模型，通过解耦底盘与手臂的潜在表示、显式引入底盘速度作为视觉预测条件，实现了更高效的参数适应与更强的物理一致性。在相同回放协议下，动作预测MSE降低21.7%，并显著提升闭环任务中的全身协调性和位移鲁棒性。新构建的ARMDOG数据集提供了关键支持，验证了解耦建模对移动操作的有效性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法核心是在冻结预训练FastWAM主干的前提下，引入四个轻量级适配模块：残差适配器实现机器人特异性微调；未来信息瓶颈蒸馏未来帧中的动作等效信号；对抗性分离的底座与手臂潜在空间解耦控制因素；底座速度直接调节视觉分支以显式建模相机自运动。这种分阶段训练既保留通用先验，又增强具身因果性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 尽管性能提升明显，但模型仍依赖高质量同步数据，且实物实验仅在一个特定平台上验证，泛化性待检验。消融显示各模块均有贡献，但未完全揭示其交互影响。最值得阅读的是其问题抽象方式——将移动操作视为需显式解耦的多因素生成过程，这对具身智能系统的建模具有启发意义。
